sites.warningDeltaHelp:
Optional buffer just outside the normal min/max range. Readings outside normal but still inside this buffer create a warning alert. Leave it empty to skip the buffer; readings outside the normal range can still warn.

Example: normal 6.5–7.5 with warning delta 0.3 → warning below 6.2 or above 7.8.
sites.criticalDeltaHelp:
Optional buffer beyond the warning range. Readings outside normal by more than this amount create a critical alert. Use a value larger than the warning delta when both are set. Leave it empty to skip critical range checks.

Example: normal 6.5–7.5 with critical delta 1 → critical below 5.5 or above 8.5.
sites.mapHint: Click the map or drag the marker to set coordinates.

sites.deleteSiteDescription: Permanently removes this site, its measurements, alerts, and sensor settings. Assigned devices are unassigned, not deleted.
sites.deleteSiteConfirm: Delete this site permanently? Assigned devices will be unassigned. All measurements, alerts, and snapshots for this site will be removed. This cannot be undone.
